answer: Seats are a fixed supply that anyone can buy out from under you. The wander is a registry of exactly 10,000 seats that files identities sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint into one cluster. A sparrow, one claimed identity, holds a seat at a self-declared price any bidder may pay to evict it, and burns basalt, a 1% tax on that price, every epoch. The k-th sparrow in a cluster must declare k times the median seat price, so at a 200-credit median 100 clones burn 10,100 basalt per epoch, and each seat they take lifts the median. Clones escaping clustering in the wander break it.
